## Query

### Imports

```{r}
#library(ShortRead)
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
```

#### DNA_Query_seqs12Mar24.fasta

```
>XLN-G9

>XME-B2

>XME-G6

>XMF-C4

```

```{bash}
!/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/mmseqs2/15-6f452/bin/mmseqs easy-search /content/DNA_Query_seqs12Mar24.fasta /content/20_VecF2_R3_S20_assemble-pass.fastq alnResult.m8 tmp \
--search-type 3
```

In this command, `/content/DNA_Query_seqs12Mar24.fasta` is the query file, `/content/20_VecF2_R3_S20_assemble-pass.fastq` is the target database (either FASTA/FASTQ file or MMseqs2 database), `alnResult.m8` is the file for alignment results, and `tmp` is a temporary directory for intermediate files.

`--search-type 3` indicates we are searching nucleotides.

## Load Search Results

```{r}
dat <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S20_VecF2_R3_S20-MMseqs2-Easy-search.m8", 
                header = F, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

# Apply column names
colnames(dat) <- c("query","target","fident","alnlen","mismatch","gapopen","qstart","qend","tstart","tend","evalue","bits")
```

#### Load Query Sequences

```{r}
tmp <- seqinr::read.fasta("~/VHH/data/DNA_Query_seqs12Mar24.fasta", 
                          as.string = TRUE,
                          forceDNAtolower = FALSE)

## Convert to data frame
results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(tmp)){
  results <- rbind(results, as.data.frame(cbind(attr(tmp[[i]], "name"), as.character(tmp[[i]]) )))
}

colnames(results) <- c("query", "query_sequence")

rm(tmp)
```

#### Load Target Database

```{r}
db <- dnar::read.fastq("~/VHH/data/20_VecF2_R3_S20_assemble-pass.fastq")

colnames(db)[1] <- "target"

head(db)
```

### Merge Results, Query Seqs, Target Seqs

```{r}
df <- merge(dat, db, by = "target", all.x = T)
# We are not concerned with quality
df$qual <- NULL

df <- merge(df, results, by = "query", all.x = T)
```



```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

```
df[df$consensus_sequence == "NTGAV",]
df[df$consensus_sequence == "YAEQGLYGDYLDY",]
```

```{r}
# Subset an interesting CDR3
tmp <- df[df$consensus_sequence == "NTGAV" & 
        df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]

#tmp <- df[df$consensus_sequence == "YAEQGLYGDYLDY" & 
#        df$f %in% c("10_L3_lh2_S10_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv"),]


# Subset all associated clones
db <- db[db$clone_id %in% tmp$cluster_id,]

# Clean-up names-- there was an error once with :
db$sequence_id <- gsub(":", '', db$sequence_id)

db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)
```

#### Final Cleanup

```{r}
# take passes, drop fails
fails <- db[which(grepl("\\*", db$VHH, fixed = F)),]
nrow(fails)
pass <- db[which(!grepl("\\*", db$VHH, fixed = F)),]
nrow(pass)

## Drop the first 10 amino acids
pass$VHH <- substr(pass$VHH, 11, nchar(pass$VHH))
```


## Write to fasta for clustering in MMseqs2

```{r}
write_fasta <- function(df, seq_col, id_col,file_out){
  seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = as.list(df[[seq_col]]), names = df[[id_col]], file.out = file_out)
}

write_fasta(pass, "VHH", "sequence_id", "~/Downloads/S10-VHH-seqs13Mar24.fasta")
```















### Load Cluster Results

```{R}
res <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-DB_clustering-H90.tsv", header = F, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
colnames(res) <- c("sequence_id", "member")
```

Keep only the values we need

```{r}
pass <- pass[,c("sequence_id", "junction_aa", "clone_id", "VHH")]
```

```{r}
tmp <- merge(res, pass, by = "sequence_id")
# Rename VHH to "centroid_VHH"
colnames(tmp)[ncol(tmp)] <- "centroid_VHH"
# Rename "sequence_id" to "centroid_sequence_id"
colnames(tmp)[1] <- "centroid_sequence_id"
# Rename "member" to "sequence_id"
colnames(tmp)[2] <- "sequence_id"
# Rename "junction_aa" to "centroid_junction_aa"
colnames(tmp)[3] <- "centroid_junction_aa"
# Rename "clone_id" to "centroid_clone_id"
colnames(tmp)[4] <- "centroid_clone_id"

# Re-merge to pull in member sequences
tmp <- merge(tmp, pass, by = "sequence_id")

# Rename columns
colnames(tmp)[which(colnames(tmp) == "junction_aa")] <- "member_junction_aa"
colnames(tmp)[which(colnames(tmp) == "sequence_id")] <- "member_sequence_id"
colnames(tmp)[which(colnames(tmp) == "clone_id")] <- "member_clone_id"
colnames(tmp)[which(colnames(tmp) == "VHH")] <- "member_VHH"
```

### Write Data

```{r}
write.csv(tmp, file = "~/Downloads/S19-NTGAV-Family-MMseqs2-H90-recluster12Mar24.csv", row.names = F)
```

## Parse Data

Try:

1. Read in a FASTA
2. Translate its sequences
3. Parse out CDR3
3. Cluster

```{r}
write_fasta <- function(df, seq_col, id_col,file_out){
  seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = as.list(df[[seq_col]]), names = df[[id_col]], file.out = file_out)
}

write_fasta(df_S19, "junction_aa", "sequence_id", "~/Downloads/S19-VHH-seqs19Feb24.fasta")
write_fasta(df_S20, "junction_aa", "sequence_id", "~/Downloads/S20-VHH-seqs19Feb24.fasta")
write_fasta(df_S21, "junction_aa", "sequence_id", "~/Downloads/S21-VHH-seqs19Feb24.fasta")
```

## Cluster Results

```{r}
# Read in clustering results
tmp <- read.table("~/Downloads/S20-DB_clustering.tsv", sep = '\t', header = F, stringsAsFactors = F)

colnames(tmp) <- c("family", "members")

cen_seqs <- vector()
mem_seqs <- vector()
for (i in 1:nrow(tmp)){
  cen_seqs[i] <- df_S20[df_S20$sequence_id == tmp$family[i],]$junction_aa
  mem_seqs[i] <- df_S20[df_S20$sequence_id == tmp$members[i],]$junction_aa
}


tmp$centroid_sequences <- cen_seqs
tmp$member_sequences <- mem_seqs
```

## Top-50 Clonal Family (2+ Members) Logo Plots

```{r, echo = F, warning=F}
tmp <- tmp[nchar(tmp$centroid_sequences) == nchar(tmp$member_sequences),]

tab <- top_groups(tmp)
# tmp <- df[df$clone_id %in% head(as.numeric(names(tab)), 25),]
  
for (nm in head(names(tab), 50)){
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$family == nm,]
  # Translate VHH
  # tmp_frame$VHH <- translate_DNA(tmp_frame$sequence_alignment)
  # Trim CDR3
  tmp_frame$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp_frame$member_sequences)
  # Pull most frequent CDR3
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$family), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      # cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}

```
